dedupe_keys.name: pycity base urban energy scenario library

description: pycity_base is a Python package from RWTH Aachen's Energy Efficient Buildings group for representing city districts and preparing urban energy scenarios. It defines building and district objects, network geometry, demand and generation series, and example workflows for assembling a local energy-system case. Users provide buildings, street or utility networks, weather and demand assumptions; outputs are structured district cases and time series that other simulators can use. Geographic coverage is a user-defined urban district and the time horizon follows input series. The repository documents an MIT licence, installation and a notebook tutorial. Its README cautions that pycity_base is distinct from an unrelated PyPI package named pycity. A limitation is that this base library prepares and holds scenarios; full thermal or grid simulation needs companion tools and local validation. It can prepare district-heating, electricity and building simulations. The catalogue's model-energyplus is a distinct building simulator. No OpenStreetMap data or package was downloaded.
